name: Narukami Kei
source:
The ghost of a girl who died in a car accident on the Yotsuya ridge many years ago. Ever since then she can be seen at times racing in her 70's vintage car down the mountain pass.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/moero2/]official English site[/url]]
